data.name: Haneefa
data.gender_notes: Haneefa is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'h-n-f', meaning 'free from sin, free from reproach, or free from servitude to other than Allah'. Haneefa represents a person who is devoted to Allah and follows His guidance. The name Haneefa carries the meaning “The Free One” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Haneefa usually hope their child will grow to embody the free one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes freedom from worldly attachments and devotion to Allah.
data.etymology: Haneefa belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Free One.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Haneefa total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.long_meaning: الحنيفة: صفة تقديس لصاحبها، ومفردة في القرآن المكية والمدنية، بمعنى المتصدق، المعتدل، المطيع، والمتبوع. وهي صفة تعني الانصياع، والتأديب، والتوحيد، والتقديس. يُشير القرآن إلى الأنبياء على عهودهم بأنهم كانوا حنفاء، أي متصديقين، مطيعين، متوحيدين. والحنيفية: صفة تقديس لمن تتبعها، ويُشير إلى شخص متوحد، متصديق، مطيع، متبع. وهي صفة تعني الانصياع، والتأديب، والتوحيد، والتقديس. في الإسلام، يشير لفظ الحنيف إلى الانصياع، والتأديب، والتوحيد، والتقديس. يُشير لفظ الحنيفية إلى شخص متوحد، متصديق، مطيع، متبع.

in_english.name: Haneefa
in_english.long_meaning: Haneefa is a name derived from the Arabic root 'H-N-F', meaning 'pious', 'obedient', 'monotheistic', 'faithful', and 'devoted'. In Islamic tradition, Haneefa is considered a virtuous name, symbolizing devotion to God and adherence to the principles of Islam. Haneefa is also associated with the concept of Tawhid, or the oneness of God. In Quranic context, Haneefa refers to the prophets who were obedient to God and followed His commands.
